brief_v2.history_line: Website launched Sep 5 · Website video reworked with real footage

performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real but 3-day purchases recovering; spend efficiency now the test.

findings.text: ROAS dropped 69.61% week-over-week; 28-day blended sits at 4.84x, but last 7d revenue per dollar has cratered as spend rose 25.69%.
3-day purchase signal (Sep 8–10): 5, 0, 1 = 6 purchases vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7): 1, 1, 2 = 4 — marginal uptick but revenue volatile; Sep 9 was zero-purchase.
5 overdue SOW milestones as of Aug 31: Live-Cooking Shoot, Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership, Funnel Test + UTM, SEO Phase 1 — none show a completed event.
GBP actions dropped 54.55% week-over-week; last 4 days in series show 0 GBP actions (Sep 7–10), suggesting a data feed gap or steep local-intent drop.
GA4 sessions fell from a 400+ peak (Sep 1–2, Sep 5, Sep 7) to 192 on Sep 10 — 3-day avg 237 vs prior-3 avg 328, a 28% drop aligned with spend softening.

suggestions.text: Hold BWS - Sales - Muslims spend flat; watch purchases Sep 11–13 to confirm 3-day recovery before any scale.
suggestions.monday_update: ROAS fell 69.61% week-over-week while spend rose 25.69%, and the 3-day purchase count (6 buys, Sep 8–10) is only marginally above the prior 3 days (4 buys). Hold daily budget flat on BWS - Sales - Muslims and do not scale until the Sep 11–13 window shows at least 6 purchases with positive revenue-per-dollar vs the 4.84x 28-day baseline. Re-check Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Escalate Funnel Test + UTM milestone (overdue Aug 31); zero UTM data blocks attribution truth and purchase read.
suggestions.monday_update: The Funnel Test Closed + UTM Live milestone was due Aug 31 and shows no completed event. Without UTMs live, the ROAS read (currently showing 4.84x 28-day, -69.61% last 7d) cannot be trusted as Windsor/Meta primary attribution remains unverified. Assign Khurram to confirm the 100%-off code test result and UTM firing status by Sep 14. Success check: at least one confirmed UTM-tagged purchase visible in Windsor by that date.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions for 3 more days; 4 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 7–10) may be a data feed issue, not true local-intent drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have read zero for four consecutive days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 25+ per day earlier in the series, and the 7-day delta is -54.55%. Before treating this as a local-intent signal, verify whether the GBP data connector is still pulling correctly. If actions remain zero through Sep 13, escalate to Nacer as a tracking fix, not an ads problem. Re-check Sep 14.
